audience: sales teams that track accounts, contacts and opportunities in Sage Sales Management

useCases.title: Review the sales opportunities and their details
useCases.text: List the sales opportunities and read their details. Open one opportunity to see its full record.

useCases.title: Review the accounts and contacts of a client
useCases.text: List the accounts and open one. Then list the contacts linked to that account.

useCases.title: Prepare a call with the logged activities
useCases.text: Get one contact by id and read its details. Check the logged activities, such as visits, calls and notes.

useCases.title: Review proposals and the product catalog
useCases.text: List the sales order headers, which are proposals drawn up for accounts, and list the products in the catalog.

useCases.title: Add a new account with its first contact
useCases.text: Create an account. Then create a contact and link it to the account with its id.

useCases.title: Log a new opportunity and update its chance of winning
useCases.text: Create an opportunity for an account with its value and chance of winning. Later, update the value, chance or comment of that opportunity.
